title: Surcharges removed on eftpos, Mastercard and Visa; lower interchange caps
summary: From 1 October 2026 merchants may not surcharge eftpos, Mastercard or Visa debit, prepaid or credit cards, and domestic interchange caps were lowered.

instruments.title: RBA Standards Nos 1-3 as varied for 1 October 2026

commenced.what: Surcharge removal and lower interchange caps

direction_rationale: Removing surcharges simplifies price comparison; lower interchange caps cut merchants' acceptance costs, which may pass through to prices.
comparison: National: event study only; foreign-card cap from 1 April 2027
